body.p: Lincoln Square appears on government plans as early as 1850. Given other local street names (e.g. Pelham Street) it seems probably that it is named after Henry Pelham-Clinton, 5th Duke of Newcastle and Earl of Lincoln who was Secretary of State for the Colonies in the early 1850s when Carlton was being laid out.
